title: Stargate recruitment: 6 of 600 people tested had real talent, and all had synesthesia
summary: Chris Ramsay tells of Stargate recruitment: 6 of 600 people tested had real talent, and all had synesthesia, about 1970s-1995 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: A magician and YouTuber, Chris Ramsay, tells on Jesse Michels' podcast about Stargate, a US government programme that ran from the 1970s to 1995 and tried to use remote viewing, meaning seeing distant places or things with the mind alone. He says the programme reached out to 600 people to find viewers, that only 6 showed real talent, and that all 6 had synesthesia, a condition where the senses blend, such as seeing colours when hearing sounds. If true, it would hint that this kind of ability is tied to how a person's brain is wired.
